sources.role: Public Defender / listed public information contact
sources.stated_purpose: Public information and media inquiries within the office remit
sources.limitations: Official public information directory explicitly publishes the address; public defender directory confirms incumbent. Address is listed for media/public information inquiries, not client intake. General main-office email is masked in retrieved pages. Public defenders provide representation within statutory or contracted remit and eligibility; no medical-grievance investigation or general civil intake authority is established. Do not transmit confidential material through ordinary email. Confirm role, mailbox, jurisdiction and channel purpose. Deliverability not tested.
